meta.grain: one row per language x resource; reach columns aggregate the people groups speaking that language
meta.country_filter_scope: A COUNTRY filter matches on the countries where a people group on this map speaks the language. The 1038 zero-reach rows therefore never match one — no group here names those languages — so filter by language or ISO code to find them. They are not attributed to a country on the basis of a "primary country" field, because the only alpha-2/alpha-3 mapping available in this repo disagrees with itself on 18 countries and cannot resolve many of the 492 codes involved; a wrong country attribution would point a real link at the wrong field.
meta.zero_reach_rows: A row with 0 people groups is a REAL published resource in a language that no people group on this map names as its primary language. It is listed because the table is every link, not every link that happens to have a pin — someone searching for that language still needs to find it.

meta.pools_caveat: Pools checked: Cru (GodTools), Door43 (unfoldingWord), Faith Comes By Hearing, Global Recordings Network, JESUS Film, PNG.Bible, Scripture Earth (SIL), Zume Training, eBible.org, eBible.org (mirror). An absence here is absence from the pools checked, never proof that nothing exists.
meta.stories_are_not_scripture: Open Bible Stories is 50 illustrated narratives drawn from the canon. It is typed as Bible Stories, never as Scripture, because telling a reader they have a translation when they have a story set is the error that matters most.
meta.doctrine_boundary: Only sources publishing the 66-book canon are included. Watchtower/JW, Seventh-day Adventist, LDS and other added-canon publishers are excluded by rule, not by oversight.
meta.no_believer_data: This table describes PUBLISHED RESOURCES only. It carries no church, believer or meeting-point data and must never gain any.
